one of the sky at dawn.

An assortment of parts salvaged
from a High Entia airship.

Wildgrass fit for consumption.
Caterpiles also love the stuff.

A Ponspector licence issued by the
Archaeology Centre.

A set of medical tools for treating the
ailments of a number of species.

A mythical herb said to turn even the
most questionable of foods palatable.

A letter sent to Melia by someone
who bears a strong connection to her.

A faded identification tag. You can
make out the name "Sovean".
A strong, yet pliable, variety of vine.
A stone with a charming pattern.

A mineral well suited to sculpting.
Also called Paleglow.

Tsukuku's beloved round mirror,
polished to an immaculate shine.

A bangle bent by some kind of
impact. It looks expensive.

A firm, vivid feather. It glows faintly
in the light.

Setichi's handmade stake.
Used in land surveying.

A stake retrieved from the Tirkin.
Watch where you point that thing!

Wood sculpture of a two-faced Nopon.
One side is calm, the other angry.

A well-looked-after camera. The
shutter sound is pleasing to the ears.

The Deinos faintly glows in the
darkness of the night.

The brilliant colours of the Eluca
stand out against the foliage.

Wanawana's memo. The handwriting
is so messy, it's illegible.

A highly effective medicinal herb.
Heals light injuries fast.

A mineral with flotative properties,
common on the Giant God's Shoulder.

A Brightite ring requested by Amleto,
refined by Kurt, to give to Winia.

A fast-track fishing tool designed by
Bartol and built by Alfreda.

Big cherry from the Shoulder's east.
The pulp is large, but delicately sweet.

A little basket labelled "Pororo's Fave".
The contents are to be dissolved.

A common tool used for mining ether
deposits. "Arara" is etched on the hilt.

An ether pick Lott reinforced for you.
Yields better output and gems.

A translucent crystal that gives off
a pale light, mystifying onlookers.

A prototype ether pick developed by
Gannett, built for ease of use.

A prototype ether pick developed by
Gannett. Now of no use to anyone.

A faintly glowing blue shard. Used as
a catalyst in refining certain metals.

Ancient foodstuff of the gods, now all
dried up. Only the legend will live on.

A carrot with all the colours of the
rainbow. The flavour varies per hue.

A bitter-tasting grey leaf. Highly
effective as a fertiliser.

A grain with a refined, mellow flavour.
The chaff can be delicious steamed.

A vegetable that fosters positivity.
Each kernel is packed with sweetness.

Known for its sweetness, this squash
is a treasured dessert ingredient.

A fish with lustrous, shining scales.
Simmer for a rich, full-flavoured broth.

This clam's remarkably hard shell
conceals a soft and buttery centre.

A mole with wing-like appendages.
Some say they've seen them fly.

A bird with wings as sharp as blades.
Can easily cut branches as it flies by.

An elephant so small it can fit in the
hand. Often hard to spot.

A machine component that looks as if
it's been split. Has many applications.

A type of metal used in machinery,
string-thin.

A bar of steel that chills to the bone,
even affecting short-term memory.

A chain that scatters sparks with the
smallest motion. Mainly for show.

A pair of stone and metal cogwheels.
Very old, but the teeth still mesh.

A stone Nene named as she skimmed
it across the water. It never stopped.

A tree branch Kino secretly named.
Could be handy for playing Heropon.

Carefully named by Melia, its light
banishes the darkness, bringing hope.

A hollowed-out object of unknown
origin, timorously dubbed by Shulk.

A beautiful pearl that Kino and Nene
named. Takes ten years to mature.

A rhino as small as a grain of sand.
Sometimes blown away in the wind.
